sections.Profile:
"Ready… Aim… Fire!," released by Premier Technology (Gottlieb) in March 1983, is a solid-state pinball machine with a military target-shooting theme. Designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Larry Day, it features two flippers and no multiball, focusing instead on strategic shots to advance through the game. The machine uses the Gottlieb System 80A hardware, and 2,436 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1983
